card.name: Suspicion and Guilt MOK
card.text: When a creature becomes suspicious, put a suspicion counter on it. Likewise, a suspicious creature is any creature with a suspicion counter on it. Whenever a suspicious creature leaves the battlefield, exile it with a guilt counter instead. A guilty card is any card, sometimes of a particular type, that is in exile with a guilt counter on it.

card.name: Weld MOK
card.text: Weld N means to create N 0/2 colorless Robot Clue artifact creature tokens with "{2}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card."
